target_customer: Qualified investors who can put in at least $100k as limited partners
problem: Discretionary hedge funds rely on human researchers. Standard Signal claims AI can research and execute every trade end to end with an auditable reasoning trail.
business_model: hedge fund with management and performance fees (fees not stated)

founders.name: Michael Royzen
founders.background_notes: YC page says machine learning roles at Lyft, Cloudflare and Microsoft.

competitors.name: Numerai
competitors.what: quant fund run on crowd and AI built models

competitors.name: Lumenai Innovation Fund
competitors.traction_then: announced for launch around June 2026, no operating history

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable autonomous research and execution within risk limits needs strong models and engineering, but a solo founder with LLM training experience can start.

defensibility.rationale: Track record would be the moat, and none is public. Other AI funds were launching at the same time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action reported. One allocator said it would not be comfortable with fully autonomous fund management.

market_need_then: Interest in AI funds was rising in 2026, but allocators were skeptical of full autonomy and the company has disclosed no assets or performance.

branding.domain_note: Uses standardsignal.com; purchase history not found.

identity.visual_style: Institutional fund site with a $100k minimum and market-neutral framing.
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, stresses explainable trades and an audit trail.

branding.brand_signature: Claim to be the first hedge fund researching and trading purely with AI
branding.community_and_virality: Launch coverage by Runtime Wire; the founder had earlier visibility through Phind.

brand_strength.rationale: Founder reputation helps, but no press about the brand itself and the 'first' claim is unverified.

outcome_analysis: Standard Signal joined YC in Spring 2026 under a second-time founder from Phind and began soliciting limited partners at a $100k minimum. It is Active with no public returns, assets or exit, so there is no outcome to explain yet. Success depends on a verifiable track record and whether investors accept autonomous trading.
notes: Aggregators list $500K pre-seed with conflicting dates (January and June 2026); unverified and not recorded as a round. An aggregator lists Standard Signal LP under a 506(b) exemption, not verified against SEC EDGAR. The self-reported Sharpe above 3 is unverified. A separate AI fund collapse story is unrelated.
